summary_1line: Jaratkaru’s son Astika is born and raised among the serpents, destined to save them, while Janamejaya begins asking about his father Parikshit’s death.

image_candidates.scene_text: The radiant child Astika is born in the palace of the serpent king Vasuki, glowing like the rising sun among gathered serpents.
Young Astika studies the Vedas beside the sage Chyavana while serpents coil quietly around the pillars of Vasuki’s palace.
King Janamejaya sits on his throne questioning his ministers about the mysterious death of his father Parikshit.
